name: paseo
description: Paseo: voice-controlled development environment for local AI coding agents

scripts.dev:server:watch: concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,server --prefix-colors yellow,blue,cyan "pnpm run watch:protocol" "pnpm run watch:client" "pnpm run dev:server:raw"
scripts.build:client:clean: pnpm run build:protocol:clean && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client run build:clean
scripts.build:server-deps: pnpm run build:client && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names highlight,plugin,relay --prefix-colors yellow,green,blue "pnpm run build:highlight" "pnpm run build:plugin" "pnpm run build:relay"
scripts.build:server-deps:clean: pnpm run build:client:clean && pnpm run build:highlight:clean && pnpm run build:plugin:clean && pnpm run build:relay:clean
scripts.build:server: pnpm run build:server-deps && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server run build && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli run build
scripts.build:server:clean: pnpm run build:server-deps:clean && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server run build:clean && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli run build:clean
scripts.build:app-deps: pnpm run build:highlight && pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:plugin && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/expo-two-way-audio run build
scripts.build:app-deps:clean: pnpm run build:highlight:clean && pnpm run build:client:clean && pnpm run build:plugin:clean && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/expo-two-way-audio run build
scripts.typecheck:server: pnpm --filter @getpaseo/relay run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/protocol run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli run typecheck
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:app-deps:clean && cd packages/app && cross-env PASEO_WEB_PLATFORM=electron npx expo export --platform web && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/desktop run build --
scripts.version: pnpm run version:sync-internal && pnpm run fdroid:changelogs && pnpm run release:prepare && git add -A
scripts.release:check: pnpm run release:prepare && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/highlight run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/relay run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/protocol run typecheck && pnpm run build:client:clean && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/plugin run typecheck && pnpm run build:server:clean && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli run typecheck && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/highlight pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/relay pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/protocol pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/plugin pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli pack --dry-run
scripts.release:publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter @getpaseo/highlight publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/relay publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/protocol publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/plugin publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:publish:beta:dry-run: pnpm --filter @getpaseo/highlight publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/relay publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/protocol publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/plugin publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta
scripts.release:publish: pnpm --filter @getpaseo/highlight publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/relay publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/protocol publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/plugin publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release:publish:beta: pnpm --filter @getpaseo/highlight publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/relay publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/protocol publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/client publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/plugin publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/server publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta && pnpm --filter @getpaseo/cli publish --access public --no-git-checks --tag beta
scripts.release:beta:patch: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:patch && pnpm run release:publish:beta && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:minor: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:minor && pnpm run release:publish:beta && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:major: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:major && pnpm run release:publish:beta && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:next: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:beta:next && pnpm run release:publish:beta && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:promote: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:promote && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:patch: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:patch && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:minor && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
scripts.release:major: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run version:all:major && pnpm run release:publish && pnpm run release:push
